determinations.title: Individual Article 19a threshold scope
determinations.caution: Threshold-crossing ranges are indeterminate — ask for the exact value. This is scope, not the final reporting duty (see CSRD-S-014); national transposition may vary timing and options.

determinations.title: Consolidated Article 29a threshold scope
determinations.caution: Use the legal consolidation perimeter, not internal business units.

determinations.title: First-wave (FY2024) reporting history
determinations.caution: Never tell a former reporter to stop based only on an EU-level threshold screen (see CSRD-S-004 and CSRD-S-013).

determinations.title: FY2025–26 national transition exemption
determinations.caution: Requires the governing country pack — this is a national option, not a universal automatic exemption.

determinations.title: Subsidiary exemption via qualifying EU-parent consolidated report
determinations.caution: Scope and exemption are separate determinations: 'threshold in scope but exempt' must never be summarised as 'CSRD does not apply'. Exemption evidence must remain current every year (O-011).

determinations.title: Subsidiary exemption via qualifying non-EU parent report
determinations.caution: 'EQUIVALENT' requires a formal equivalence basis — treat as legal judgment with a signed DecisionRecord until an equivalence decision exists.

determinations.title: Article 40a third-country group gate
determinations.reasonCopy: A fact we need is missing

needs.label: Group EU turnover, year before that

determinations.title: Article 40a subsidiary gateway
determinations.caution: The subsidiary is a publication gateway, not necessarily the reporting parent. Art. 40a reporting runs for financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2028 (R-012).

determinations.title: Applicable ESRS version

sources.title: Commission revised ESRS delegated act, adopted 3 Jul 2026

determinations.caution: The revised ESRS were adopted 3 Jul 2026 but were NOT in force at the pack snapshot; they must not alter current obligations until legal effectiveness (Change Watch CW-001).

determinations.title: National-law completeness gate
determinations.reasonCopy: National law is not encoded yet
determinations.caution: CSRD is directive-based law. A negative EU-level threshold result with this gate unresolved must read 'EU-level threshold not met; national-law status requires review' — never 'CSRD does not apply'.

determinations.title: Reporting duty (post-exemption)
determinations.caution: A standalone promotional sustainability report is not automatically sufficient. First reporting year and filing calendar resolve through the national overlay (S-013) and timing rules (R-005: generally FY beginning on or after 1 Jan 2027 for non-first-wave reporters).

determinations.title: Limited assurance over sustainability reporting
determinations.caution: Provider eligibility and appointment rules require the national overlay. Limited assurance remains the mandatory level; the assurance standard is due by 1 July 2027.

determinations.title: First-three-years value-chain transition relief
determinations.reasonCopy: A fact we need is missing
determinations.caution: Track the first reporting year as a sourced fact.
